items.headline: Vikings left at QB crossroads after Carson Wentz's poor MNF showing vs. Bills
items.description: After a historically poor performance by Carson Wentz on Monday night, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell was asked whether the team might trade for a QB ahead of Tuesday's deadline. He deferred the question to GM Nolan Teasley.
